general - relationship - specific.cyper_for_intermediate_page: MATCH (variant:sequence_variant)-[r:part_of_QTL_signal]->(gene:coding_elements {id:"@gene@"}) WITH CASE WHEN r.data_source="GTEx; SusieR" THEN "GTEx; SusieR" WHEN r.data_source="INSPIRE; SusieR" THEN "INSPIRE; SusieR" WHEN r.data_source="splicing; GTEx" THEN "splicing; GTEx" WHEN r.data_source="exon; INSPIRE" THEN "exon; INSPIRE" ELSE "Other" END AS data_source, r, variant WITH data_source, COLLECT({snp: variant.id, credible_set_id: r.credible_set, data_source: r.data_source, pip: r.pip, n_snp: r.n_snp, purity: r.purity, nominal_p: r.nominal_p, lbf: r.lbf, effect_allele: r.effect_allele}) AS credible_sets RETURN data_source, credible_sets ORDER BY data_source;

general - relationship - specific.cypher_for_result_page_nbr: MATCH (variant:sequence_variant {id: "@lead_snp@"}), (g:gene {id: "@gene@"}) CALL { WITH g MATCH (g)-[r1:effector_gene_of]-(nbr1) RETURN collect(DISTINCT r1) AS eff_edges, collect(DISTINCT nbr1) AS eff_nbrs } CALL { WITH g MATCH (g)-[rReg:regulation]-(nbrR:gene) WITH rReg, nbrR ORDER BY id(rReg) LIMIT 2 RETURN collect(rReg) AS reg_edges, collect(nbrR) AS reg_nbrs } CALL { WITH g MATCH (g)-[rBind:physical_binding]-(nbrB:gene) WITH rBind, nbrB ORDER BY id(rBind) LIMIT 2 RETURN collect(rBind) AS bind_edges, collect(nbrB) AS bind_nbrs } CALL { WITH variant MATCH (variant)-[r0]-(nbr0) WITH r0, nbr0 LIMIT 1 RETURN collect(r0) AS var_edges, collect(nbr0) AS var_nbrs } WITH [g, variant] AS seed_nodes, eff_edges + reg_edges + bind_edges + var_edges AS all_edges, eff_nbrs + reg_nbrs + bind_nbrs + var_nbrs AS all_nbrs UNWIND (seed_nodes + all_nbrs) AS n WITH collect(DISTINCT n) AS nodes, all_edges UNWIND all_edges AS e RETURN nodes, collect(DISTINCT e) AS edges;

empirical_evidence.title: Regional Fine-Mapping Plot
empirical_evidence.description:
This plot integrates multiple fine-mapping statistics (−log₁₀P, PIP, LBF) across a genomic region. The three-row scatter view condenses QTL evidence.
Row 1 shows −log₁₀ P for classical association strength.
Row 2 reports the posterior inclusion probability (PIP) from Bayesian fine-mapping.
Row 3 displays the log Bayes factor (LBF) for complementary Bayes support.
Point colour encodes LD R² relative to the lead SNP (red dashed line), allowing you to gauge how neighbouring variants track the core signal.
Together these layers highlight candidate causal variants and their statistical weight at a glance.
